title: STILL PRESENT (r2): single-slot refcheck_edit still discards another row's in-progress typed trio on a second action choice or any action success
evidence: RefcheckSubstitute -> #( Model( ..menu_closed, refcheck_edit: Some(prefill_refcheck_edit( model, call_id, RefcheckEditSubstitute, )), ), ... RefcheckCorrect -> #( ... refcheck_edit: Some(prefill_refcheck_edit( model, call_id, RefcheckEditCorrect, ... let edit = case model.refcheck_edit { Some(e) if e.call_id == call_id -> e _ -> prefill_refcheck_edit( model, call_id, refcheck_edit_kind_for(model, call_id), ) ... Ok(_) -> { let cleared = Model( ..model, refcheck_edit: None,
detail: The r2 rework fixed the always-open render (button-gated) and Cancel-closes, but the model stays a single Option(RefcheckEdit): choosing substitute/correct on row B, typing in row B, or any successful action still overwrites/closes row A's open edit, silently dropping typed unsaved PII.
recommended_fix: Guard the choice/edit arms: keep the open edit when the new call_id differs (or confirm before replacing); clear refcheck_edit on success only when it belongs to the acted call_id.
